fields.label: Default Provider
fields.description: Zoom and Microsoft Teams are coming soon. Other apps can add providers through a hook - see docs/ADDING_A_PROVIDER.md.

fields.label: Add a video meeting by default
Company Google Calendar
fields.description: Connected once by an admin under Google Calendar. All meetings are created on this calendar, so sales users never have to log in to Google.

fields.label: Use each user's own Google Calendar when they have one
fields.description: Off: every meeting is created on the company calendar above. On: a user with their own connected Google Calendar organizes their own meetings.

fields.label: Send in-app CRM notifications when a meeting is scheduled, changed or cancelled
Send reminders before a meeting starts
Early reminder (minutes before, 0 = off)
fields.description: For example 1440 sends a second reminder one day before.

fields.label: Email reminders to CRM team members
Also email reminders to external guests
Remind the follow-up owner when a follow-up is due
Escalate after this many calls in a row that were not picked or connected (0 = off)
fields.description: After this many calls in a row without a connect, a note is added to the Lead and its owner and the Sales Managers are notified.

fields.label: Lead status to set when escalated
fields.description: Optional. Leave empty to only notify.

fields.label: Score Leads from their activity
fields.description: A 0-100 score from calls, outcomes, meetings and recent activity, shown as the Lead Score column and on the Follow-ups tab.

fields.label: Alert the owner after this many days without activity (0 = off)
fields.description: Open Leads with no comment, email, call, task, note, follow-up or meeting for this long.

fields.label: Default WhatsApp message after a missed call
fields.default: Hi, I just tried to call you but could not reach you. When is a good time to talk?
fields.description: Offered when a call is logged as Did Not Pick or Did Not Connect and WhatsApp is set up in CRM.

fields.label: Show a "Schedule Meeting" button on Lead pages
fields.description: Turn this off if your CRM already has a Meetings tab.

fields.label: Show "Meetings" and "Follow-ups" buttons on the Leads list pages
Show an "Add Follow Up" button at the top of the Lead page (next to Schedule Meeting)
Show floating Meetings / Follow-ups buttons on the Kanban view of Leads
Show links in the side menu
fields.description: Adds the Sales Dashboard (it also holds Lead Nurturing), Follow-ups, Meetings and Campaigns to CRM's left menu, and to the Dashboard page header.

fields.label: Add Meetings and Follow-ups tabs to Lead pages
Hide "Deals" from the CRM side menu
fields.description: Only hides it from the screen. The Deals pages are still there for anyone who opens their address.

fields.label: Hide "Notes" from the CRM side menu
fields.description: Only hides it from the screen. The Notes pages are still there for anyone who opens their address.

fields.label: Hide "Tasks" from the CRM side menu
fields.description: Only hides it from the screen. The Tasks pages are still there for anyone who opens their address.

fields.label: Hide "Call Logs" from the CRM side menu
fields.description: Only hides it from the screen. The Call Logs pages are still there for anyone who opens their address.

fields.label: Hide the "Convert to Deal" button on the Lead page
fields.description: Only hides the button. It matches the button's label, so it may need a look after a CRM update.

fields.label: Messages per batch
fields.description: How many messages one dispatcher tick hands to the workers, per campaign.

fields.label: Maximum messages per minute (per campaign)
fields.description: Keep this under your Meta throughput and your mail provider's limits.

fields.label: Automatic retries
fields.description: Only for failures that prove the provider did not accept the message (rate limits, connection errors).

fields.label: WhatsApp consent
fields.options:
Require opt-in
Allow unless opted out
fields.description: Meta requires opt-in for marketing messages. 'Require opt-in' sends only to leads with the WhatsApp Opt-in box ticked, unless the campaign owner confirms consent on the campaign.

fields.label: Default country code
fields.description: For example 91. Added to WhatsApp numbers of up to 10 digits that have no country code.

fields.label: Warn me when a campaign has problems
fields.description: Checked every 5 minutes while a campaign runs. The campaign owner is notified.

fields.label: Failure rate that triggers a warning
Only after this many messages in the last hour
Message prices (for campaign cost and ROI)
Price per email
fields.description: In your company currency. Leave empty if you do not want a cost shown.
